description: Upload a file as an attachment to a task or custom field. Supports base64 data, web URLs, or local file paths.

auth_header.description: Optional Authorization header for authenticated URL downloads.

chunk_is_last.description: Set true on the final chunk to trigger assembly and upload.

chunk_session.description: Chunked upload session ID (from prior large file upload).

file_data.description: Base64-encoded file content. Files >10MB are automatically chunked.

file_name.description: File name. Required when uploading via file_data.

file_url.description: Web URL (http/https) or absolute local path. Alternative to file_data.

listName.description: List name to narrow task search.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: upload_attachment
